SSPS.description: Surface Spring Support (SSPS). Distributed spring support assigned per element (entity key); each entry in ITEMS is one spring definition whose applicable fields depend on ELEM_TYPE (FRAME uses WIDTH; every type except PLANAR(FACE) uses EDGE_FACE).

ITEMS.description: List of surface spring support definitions assigned to the element key.

ID.description: Serial number of this item within the element key. Defaults to 0 (auto).

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of the Boundary Group this spring belongs to. Must reference an existing boundary group name when non-empty; leave blank for no group.

ELEM_TYPE.description: Type of element the spring is applied to (case-insensitive). "FRAME", "PLANAR(FACE)", "PLANAR(EDGE)", or "SOLID".

EDGE_FACE.description: [ELEM_TYPE!=PLANAR(FACE)] Edge/face or local-axis index. For FRAME this is the local axis (Local x: 2, Local y: 0, Local z: 1); for PLANAR(EDGE)/SOLID this is the edge/face index (Edge#1: 0, Edge#2: 1, Edge#3: 2, Edge#4: 3). Ignored for PLANAR(FACE).

WIDTH.description: [ELEM_TYPE=FRAME] Width over which the spring stiffness is distributed. Applied only for FRAME elements.
